aiAgent.blankTitle: You don't seem to have any AI agent.
aiAgent.blankDescription: Create a new AI agent to orchestrate LLM instances and MCP servers.
aiAgent.newSubtitle: Orchestrate LLMs, tools and MCP servers.
aiAgent.notDeleted: The {{name}} AI Agent was not deleted

persona.title: Personas
persona.description: Allowed voices for this agent. Pick the catalog and one default; chat flows can switch the active persona mid-conversation.

slot.title: Slots
slot.description: Typed-variable catalogue for this agent. Chat-flow nodes pick from these instead of free-text identifiers so captured values land in a stable schema.
slot.dialogDescription: Slots are the typed variables this agent can write into. Pick a name and a primitive type.
slot.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the slot "{{name}}"? Chat-flow nodes referencing it will lose their binding.
slot.blankDescription: Create the typed variables your chat flows will collect — name, address, age, etc. Each slot has a name and a primitive type.
slot.nameHint: Letters, digits and underscores; must start with a letter or underscore.
slot.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — what this slot captures and how flows should use it.
slot.extractFromDocumentHint: When on, this slot is filled automatically from an uploaded document (CV, invoice, form) even when the caller names no slots. The slots flagged here are this agent's document-extraction schema.
slot.validationPatternHint: Optional Java regex an extracted value must fully match to be saved; also given to the model as a formatting hint.

errors.nameInvalid: Name must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits and underscores
errors.nameTaken: A slot with this name already exists for this agent

dashboard.ragDisabledDesc: Toggle on to ground answers in your data.
dashboard.intentsDesc: Predefined intents the agent can recognise and route.
dashboard.chatFlowDesc: Visual flows that orchestrate multi-step conversations.
dashboard.historyDesc: Past conversations grouped by completed flow runs.
dashboard.livePreviewDesc: The assembled system message for a previewed turn, broken down by origin.
dashboard.triggerConflictsDesc: Chat flows whose trigger descriptions overlap enough that the router may swing between them.
dashboard.analyticsIntentDesc: The per-agent analytics intent catalog used by the MLT intent classifier.

systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.description: The behavioral contract sent to the model on every turn — and a live preview of how it is assembled.

preview.title: Live Preview
preview.description: Everything below is concatenated into one system message before it reaches the model. Each block is tagged with where it comes from.
preview.noFixedText: No fixed text — depends on the live conversation.
preview.toolsNote: Provided to the model as function/tool schemas (not literal prompt text).
preview.hoverHint: Hover a passage to see where it comes from
preview.messageListNote: The full ordered list of messages sent to the model: the system message, the history-prefix turns prepended from memory, then the recent conversation.
preview.systemMessageRef: The assembled system message shown above.
preview.recentWindowRef: …then the client's recent conversation window (the latest user/assistant turns).
preview.replayVerbatim: Turn {{n}} loaded verbatim — the exact prompt sent at that turn
preview.replayUnresolved: No persisted state for this conversation — showing a plain turn
preview.toolTraceNote: What the model actually called during this conversation (recent, capped) — read against the prompt above.

note.personaReplay: The persona the runtime resolved for the replayed conversation (honouring any flow persona switch).
note.personaSwitched: Switched by the selected flow's persona node — this is the voice for the previewed turn, not the agent's default persona.
note.personaOverrideMissing: The selected flow has a persona node pointing at a persona not in this agent's catalog — the runtime silently falls back to the default (shown here). Fix the node's persona or add it to the agent.
note.personaDefault: Default persona — applies on every turn unless a chat flow switches it.
note.agentFallbackDefault: Fallback default — this agent has no system prompt of its own.
note.mcp: Injected from each enabled MCP server's LLM instructions.
note.capability: Opt-in capability guidance appended to the agent prompt.
note.skill: Skill catalog (progressive disclosure) — the run_skill delegation surface.
note.flowReplay: From the chat flow, rebuilt at the conversation's real cursor node and collected slots.
note.flow: From the selected chat flow. The runtime picks the active node by conversation state — this shows the entry node.
note.memorySummary: When the conversation grows past the compression threshold, older turns are summarized (T115) into a single block here — ahead of the recent window.
note.memoryRelevance: At runtime the older turns most relevant to the user's message are retrieved (T30) and replayed here, after the summary.

warnings.title: Conflict check
warnings.description: Heuristic checks run automatically. Run the deep check to have the LLM look for subtler contradictions that could break a reply.
warnings.clean: No conflicts detected. Run the deep check for a thorough LLM review.

empty_system_prompt.message: This agent has no system prompt; it falls back to a generic default.
empty_system_prompt.hint: Write a system prompt that defines the agent's scope, tone, and boundaries.

system_prompt_too_long.message: The assembled system prompt is {{length}} characters — large prompts inflate token cost and dilute the model's attention.
system_prompt_too_long.hint: Trim redundant guidance, or move stable reference material into a tool or RAG store.

language_directive_conflict.message: Conflicting response-language directives: {{langs}}. The model gets contradictory instructions about which language to answer in.
language_directive_conflict.hint: Keep a single response-language rule across the agent prompt and the persona, or scope each one to an explicit condition.

persona_vocab_contradiction.message: The persona lists "{{term}}" as both required and forbidden vocabulary.
persona_vocab_contradiction.hint: Remove the term from one of the two lists.

forbidden_term_in_prompt.message: The agent prompt uses "{{term}}", which the default persona forbids — the persona will be told to rephrase its own instructions.
forbidden_term_in_prompt.hint: Rephrase the agent prompt to avoid the forbidden term, or drop it from the persona's forbidden list.

redundant_persona_instruction.message: The default persona's instruction largely duplicates the agent system prompt.
redundant_persona_instruction.hint: Keep each layer focused — the agent prompt for scope/behavior, the persona for voice — to avoid sending the same text twice.

flow_persona_not_in_catalog.message: Flow "{{flow}}" has a persona node pointing at persona "{{persona}}", which is not in this agent's persona catalog. The runtime silently falls back to the default persona.
flow_persona_not_in_catalog.hint: Add that persona to the agent, or fix the node to reference an allowed persona.

flow_persona_audience_only.message: Flow "{{flow}}" switches to persona "{{persona}}", which is audience-only and cannot be a speaker. The runtime falls back to the default persona.
flow_persona_audience_only.hint: Use a persona whose kind is SPEAKER or BOTH for a flow voice switch.

cross_segment_redundancy.message: The rule "{{rule}}" is repeated across {{segments}} — the model pays for the same instruction more than once (~{{tokens}} wasted tokens).
cross_segment_redundancy.hint: Keep the rule in one layer and delete the copies to save tokens and avoid drift.

cross_segment_contradiction.message: Contradiction between {{segments}}: a directive is stated one way in one segment and negated in another. The model gets opposite instructions on the same point.
cross_segment_contradiction.hint: Reconcile the two segments so a single, consistent rule governs this behavior.

deep_check_unavailable.message: No default LLM is configured or enabled, so the deep conflict analysis can't run.
deep_check_unavailable.hint: Set a default LLM in Global Settings to enable the deep check.

deep_check_failed.hint: Try again; if it persists, check the default LLM's status.

deep_check_note.hint: This is the raw model analysis (it wasn't structured).

llm.title: Language Models
llm.description: Select one or more LLM instances for this agent.

tools.title: Native Tools
tools.description: Select which native tool callings are available to this agent.

capabilities.title: Tools & Capabilities
capabilities.description: Choose, per function, who provides each capability — Turing's own tools or a provider-native one. Same-function options are mutually exclusive; everything else coexists in the same turn.

requestOptions.title: Request Options
requestOptions.description: Tune how this agent's calls are made — reasoning, output, cost/tier, safety and provenance knobs. These change request shape, not the tools the model can invoke.

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.description: Select one or more MCP servers for tool access.

customTool.title: Custom Tools
customTool.description: Select which Groovy-backed custom tools are available to this agent.
